study.question: Does the post-pooling norm constraint suppress incremental utility of the current target-conditioned readout when added to pooled_observed, beyond context queries and duplicate evidence?
study.hypothesis: Observed seed-42 fusion_target AUC 0.6303714619147884 exceeds pooled_observed 0.6302753100663608 by only 0.0000961518484276, fusion_context by 0.0000641824945161 and fusion_uniform by 0.0000380817963694. Its wall time is 1058.88 versus 834.09 seconds and inference 31.19 versus 27.52 seconds; context has lower Logloss (0.1926727894 versus target 0.1927192416). Ancestor diagnostics confirm summaries differ and the added residual is active, but those are not utility evidence. Source inspection shows _match_norm removes all raw vector magnitude whenever raw norm exceeds 1e-6 and substitutes the pooled vector otherwise. The raw weighted-average magnitude may carry relevance/cancellation information not captured by its direction plus pooled norm. Removing only this final constraint may improve target-specific incremental utility. This is a falsifiable follow-up to a weak positive/null-controlled trajectory, not a confirmed explanation.

inherited_components: Every full pooled_observed parent branch and all supplied static/history fields.
Round-18 scorer, query choices, semantic target-match groups, separate field reads, fixed group mass, raw readout, residual head and its zero-final initialization.
Frozen training/scoring protocol, loss and optimizer defaults.

Round-18 four-cell normalized control lineage, including its near-null and negative comparisons. All nine available sources were SHA256-verified; candidate.py initially matched the incumbent byte-for-byte.
study.proposed_difference: Retain raw readout magnitude by replacing only the returned summary with the existing raw tensor. Four standalone cells cross raw scaling with target/context/uniform/pooled_duplicate retrieval, completing a normalization-by-readout factorial against four frozen normalized records. The inherited norm calculation still executes but its output is unused by the raw head; backward and measured cost can differ. Same parameter count (expected 17,270,691 total; 192,003 dense), allocation order, random draws and initial parent function in all matched pairs. This is a focused mechanism contrast, not a new architecture or verified novel contribution.
predictions: Source checks must show all inherited code identical apart from CONFIG and the renamed class, with no new parameter allocations in the wrapper. Host diagnostics must show summary=raw, normalized counterpart reconstruction and parent reproduction within floating-point tolerance, finite logits, masked mass zero and conserved group masses.

If the normalization constraint limits useful target retrieval, raw_target should beat its normalized counterpart and both source bests, and outperform raw_context and both raw duplicate-evidence controls. A positive normalization-by-query interaction should survive paired seeds.

If removal merely changes generic embedding scale/optimization or duplicates evidence, raw_context, raw_uniform or raw_pooled_duplicate may reproduce the improvement; this does not support target complementarity.

Raw versus normalized norms may differ and checkpoint intervention may alter logits; either diagnostic can be nonzero without any AUC benefit. Cost is to be measured by host; no speedup or equal-compute claim is predicted.
falsifiers: No raw-vs-reference norm difference or trained residual sensitivity: magnitude-removal intervention has little effective scope on that checkpoint. This limits this implementation, not all magnitude mechanisms.
raw_target fails to beat pooled_observed, the strongest source; incremental utility remains unsupported even if it beats balanced_target.
Context or duplicate controls equal/exceed raw_target, or the normalization-by-query interaction is absent/reverses across paired seeds; a target-specific explanation is unsupported.
A single-seed gain disappears/reverses on paired 43/44 repeats, or achieved quality requires an unjustified measured cost increase; retain preliminary/null or cost-dominated conclusion.

Nonfinite outputs, broken masking/permutation/padding invariance, mismatched parent reproduction, source hash mismatch or protocol violation invalidate the affected run rather than providing scientific counterevidence.
alternative_explanations: Sampling/seed variation and repeated validation selection; no significance claim from one run.
Generic residual head benefit: normalized uniform already improves AUC over pooled_observed by approximately 0.00005807.
Scale conditioning, cancellation and gradients in shared embeddings rather than relevance intensity; source DIN uses a different unnormalized mechanism.
Target-match groups retain target dependence even with context queries.
Pooled-duplicate key/value compression and global group softmax differ from event-level fixed group masses; allocated capacity does not imply matched effective capacity or measured compute.
Existing source performance depends on publisher static snapshots with undocumented as-of dates and a 128-event causal truncation; no production point-in-time or external-task generalization claim.

cost_plan.estimate_ref: run://r-001 context.remaining_seconds=18910.3823 at entry, protocol trial cap=1760.9324 s. Observed normalized walls: target 1058.8815, context 1058.0188, uniform 1031.9083, pooled_duplicate 894.4578; total=4043.2665 s. Plan ~4400 s for four raw cells including bounded host diagnostics; worst-case four caps=7043.7297 s. Preparation, source access, diagnostics, failed runs and assessment all count. No training/installations/local empirical scoring authorized here.
cost_plan.attribution_reserve: Three controls are explicitly included among the four charged variants; none is a free diagnostic. Retain every failure/partial receipt and never auto-retry unknown execution. If reserve permits, paired 43/44 repeats should include raw_context and the strongest raw duplicate control; do not spend the reserve on further architecture tuning.
cost_plan.assessment_reserve: Reserve approximately 11000 s for ten validation training/assessment units (~1100 each): two added paired seeds for a suite of up to five models, prioritizing selected raw candidate, its exact normalized counterpart, pooled_observed and the closest query/evidence controls. Freeze exact source/config hashes, selected suite and seed list after validation selection and before final repetitions. The weaker balanced_target remains a frozen seed-42 utility reference if not repeated. No test/withheld feedback is available or requested. Repetition omissions must be reported; this proposal itself supplies no repeated result.
cost_plan.stop_rule: Use the actual host ledger, subtracting preparation and failures from the entry snapshot; never raise the hard budget or per-trial cap. Four worst-case caps plus the nominal final reserve total 18043.7297 s, leaving only 866.6526 s at entry for other charges. If the actual ledger no longer covers necessary attribution/assessment, halt expansion, preserve receipts, and report incomplete/preliminary comparisons. Stop on integrity failure; do not call failed execution scientific refutation or exhaustion success.
